derivative.description: Independent open-front utility jacket derived from the licensed shirt and body topology, with long fitted sleeves, original arm and torso skin weights, added cloth clearance, subtle geometric folds and a raised front opening that leaves the inner top visible.
derivative.runtime: Loaded locally as glTF 2.0, rebound to identically named VRM bones and recolored by the selected wardrobe item. The base inner top remains visible.
